cohort: Hospitalized infants with charts closed between January 1 and June 30, 2020 at the Breastfeeding Ward at Hospital Central de Maputo.
finding: A simplified reporting system enabled calculation of key PITC indicators, including a 97.7% infant testing coverage, a 6.5% infant HIV infection rate, an 80.6% linkage to ART among infected infants, an 80.5% maternal HIV testing rate and a 3.0% newly positive maternal HIV rate.
